scenes.name: Problem & Architecture Overview
scenes.subtitle: Enterprise code contains confidential IP & credentials that must never leak to cloud LLMs. Sentinel-AI guarantees an offline-first airgap.
scenes.text: Enterprise code contains proprietary secrets that must never leak to third-party cloud LLMs. Sentinel-AI solves this through an offline-first hybrid AI architecture for Google BuildHybridAI 2026, pairing on-device Gemini Nano 4 with Gemini 2.5 Pro via Firebase AI Logic and App Check attestation.

scenes.name: Zero-Leakage Local AST Edge Vault
scenes.subtitle: High-entropy database credentials and API keys are intercepted at the AST level and tokenized into [VAULT_TOKEN_001] before model egress.
scenes.text: In Scene 2, we inspect code with a production database password. Sentinel-AI's on-device AST engine intercepts and tokenizes credentials into reversible vault tokens in sub-millisecond time. Zero plaintext bytes escape to the cloud, satisfying SOC 2 and GDPR Article 32.

scenes.name: On-Device Generative AI (Gemini Nano 4)
scenes.subtitle: For 85%+ of standard vulnerabilities (SQLi, Command Injection, Path Traversal), inference runs 100% on-device at $0 compute cost.
scenes.text: For standard vulnerabilities like SQL Injection and Command Injection, Sentinel-AI runs inference entirely on-device with Gemini Nano 4. With Chrome Built-in AI and edge NPU acceleration, local triage completes in sub-15 milliseconds at zero compute cost with a 100% airgap.

scenes.name: Self-Healing Unified Diff & Verification Tests
scenes.subtitle: Sentinel-AI generates compliant diff --git patches replacing dynamic string concatenation with parameterized prepared statements.
scenes.text: Sentinel-AI automatically synthesizes atomic unified diffs, replacing unsafe dynamic queries with parameterized prepared statements. Simultaneously, it auto-generates executable node:test invariant suites proving that attack payloads are rejected.

scenes.name: Intelligent Cloud Escalation to Gemini 2.5 Pro
scenes.subtitle: When cross-service taint or architectural CWEs are detected, Sentinel-AI escalates to Gemini 2.5 Pro via Firebase AI Logic.
scenes.text: When complex multi-file taint trajectories are detected, Sentinel-AI intelligently escalates to Gemini 2.5 Pro via Firebase AI Logic. Every cloud call is guarded by verified Firebase App Check attestation, tracing data flow across multiple services.

scenes.name: Multi-Platform Chrome Extension (Manifest V3)
scenes.subtitle: Sentinel-AI runs natively inside Chrome. Inspects GitHub & GitLab Pull Requests directly in the browser DOM.
scenes.text: Multi-platform by design: The Sentinel-AI Chrome Extension inspects pull request diffs directly inside GitHub and GitLab. It injects on-device security audit banners, provides inline annotations, and exports compliant OASIS SARIF v2.1.0 reports.
